acceptable_hypotheses: The duplicate receipt refers to separate transactions and does not explain two ledger commits for one order.
Client retry timing alone does not provide transaction deduplication.
contributing_factors: Queue redelivery also occurred but involved different transaction references.
corrective_actions: Reconcile ledger records through the approved finance workflow.
Apply and test stable transaction-level idempotency.
expected_findings: Two ledger commits share one simulated order reference.
Retry handling changed before the duplicate transaction alert.
resolution_details: The retry path was paused while transaction reconciliation and a guarded idempotency change were prepared.
root_cause: The changed payment retry path lacked idempotency protection, allowing a repeated checkout request to commit a second transaction.
